nom: Origins Clear Improvement Blackhead Clearing Mask-to-Scrub

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including a strong T-zone into their 40s and a teenage son's acne-prone skin, report the mask absorbs excess oil and reduces blackheads without extra dryness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin or dry patches say the mask cleared blackheads and exfoliated gently without burning or leaving their skin dry.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin reports clearer, smoother skin and fewer breakouts with regular use, using it for only a few minutes at a time rather than the full 10.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin most often report no irritation or redness even with the physical scrub and salicylic acid, though one found the scrub texture itself unpleasant and would not repurchase.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin or dry patches say the mask does not strip or dry out their skin; one reviewer notes the salicylic acid can be drying if left on for the full recommended 10 minutes rather than a shorter time.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers dealing with acne, hormonal breakouts or teen acne report clearer skin and fewer blackheads with regular use, including one whose chin breakout cleared within a week; none describe new breakouts caused by the product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily, shine-prone skin report the mask absorbs excess oil on the nose and T-zone and reduces blackheads, leaving skin less greasy through the day.

aspects.libelle: Fine gritty scrub exfoliates on rinse-off
Small amount needed, jar lasts a long time
Tube can be hard to fully empty
Scrub texture felt too abrasive for some

extraits.texte: This clearing mask has salicylic acid in it, thus I thought it was a chemical exfoliant but it actually has quite an abrasive physical texture for the scrub part. I have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate me, but I just didn't like how it felt while washing it off. It left my skin soft, and my dark sebaceous filaments look lighter on my chin and nose. However, I wouldn't repurchase it. Gifted by Origins in exchange for my honest review.

I have combination skin and have pretty much tried everything since ive been dealing with acne since my late teens. I took a chance with this because its kjnda pricy for somebody whos used to drug store products. But i would say your getting what you pay for. It's definitely an upgrade. My skin has cleared up. Its like a grainy scrub mask just as it claims. However, i use it morning and night with my regular routine except i leave it on less time. Maybe like 2-4 minutes while i brush my teeth (the bottle says 10 minutes) . I dont reccomend leaving it on longer because the salicylic acid will dry out your skin. I use a good moisterizer to balance this. But yeah clearer and smoother skin. This my experience, it may vary on your skin type and how you use it. I will continue to buy this product.

Gifted by origins- I have oily acne prone skin and this clearing mask and scrub helped so much with clearing blackheads and cleansing my face. I recommend using about a pea size amount, a little product goes a long way!

I suffer from ingrown hairs and dry patches. This mask/scrub hybrid is great because it exfoliates while clearing my skin of blackheads. It's super gentle and does not burn/leave my skin feeling sensitive. Gifted by origins

I've always had oily skin and still battle with a strong t-zone into my 40s. I constantly deal with blackheads, especially on my nose and up in between my brows. So, I love a good mask and this one delivers. It was easy to apply, dried pretty quickly and I could feel the oils being soaked up. The light lemony-spearmint scent is nice as well. Once it was time to remove the mask, I could feel the extra exfoliants scrub my pores, leaving them so smooth and clean. My pores looked great afterwards. This was very gently on my skin, so I'm excited to let my teen son try it out for his acne-prone skin. Gifted by Origins.

I tried this mask-to-scrub for the first time and was pleasantly surprised. It has a refreshing scent, and my skin felt much cleaner and softer after using it. I have dry skin and was worried it might dry me out, but my skin felt great afterward. Overall, it's a good product that cleans well without causing dryness. It was gifted by Origins for my honest review.

Complimentary from Origins, this product is fantastic. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin, and after using it as directed, my skin felt smooth and refreshed without any redness. I love how it leaves my skin looking and feeling great. It's a new favorite mask in my skincare routine!
